messages.subject: Bounds
parts:
How can I find out the preset bounds?
How can I edit them?

I wondered if in the bandit2arm the upper bound on inverse temperature is 5 (at least I'm guessing that from the distribution of the modelled parameters, but from the modelled parameters I observe I think the upper bound on inverse temperature is higher that that in prl_rp? 

Thanks for a great package by the way

Graham Murray

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: Bounds
parts:
Hi Graham,

Thanks for your kind words. All codes are available in our GitHub repo and you can check each model's Stan code to find out the bounds: https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/tree/master/exec

Here is the link for the bandit2arm_delta mode where the upper bound of tau (inverse temperature) is set to 5 (line 25): https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/blob/master/exec/bandit2arm_delta.stan. I set the upper bound to 5 because it's a reasonable value and posteriors rarely exceed the value. Let us know if the upper bound is causing a problem in your data.

We are updating our pipeline to make it easy to add/edit models. For now, to edit bounds of a parameter, you need to edit its Stan and R codes and rebuild the package. 

Best,
Young
